features.name: Darkvision
features.description: Can see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

features.name: Fey Ancestry
features.description: Advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.

features.name: Skill Versatility
features.description: Gain proficiency in two skills of your choice (Perception, Acrobatics).

features.name: Bardic Inspiration
features.description: As a bonus action, grant one creature within 60 feet a d8 Bardic Inspiration die. Uses equal to Charisma modifier (4) per short or long rest.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Charisma-based spellcasting. Spell save DC 15, spell attack bonus +7. Use a musical instrument as a spellcasting focus.

features.name: Jack of All Trades
features.description: Add half your proficiency bonus (rounded down, +1) to any ability check that doesn't already include your proficiency bonus.

features.name: Song of Rest
features.description: During a short rest, you and friendly creatures who hear your performance regain an extra 1d6 hit points if they spend at least one Hit Die.

features.name: Expertise
features.description: Double proficiency bonus for two skill proficiencies: Performance and Persuasion.

features.name: Bard College: College of Lore
features.description: Bonus Proficiencies in three skills of your choice (Arcana, History, Acrobatics — note: Acrobatics from Half-Elf, so this grants Arcana, History, and the extra covered by Skill Versatility).

features.name: Cutting Words
features.description: As a reaction, when a creature within 60 feet makes an attack roll, ability check, or damage roll, expend one Bardic Inspiration die to subtract the result from the creature's roll.

features.name: Font of Inspiration
features.description: Bardic Inspiration dice are regained on a short or long rest.

spells_known.description: Bonus action, 60 ft range, 1d4 + Cha mod healing

spells_known.description: 10 ft radius, 3d8 thunder damage, Con save for half

spells_known.name: Hypnotic Pattern

spells_known.description: End one spell of 3rd level or lower on a target; higher levels require ability check

traits: Knows a story relevant to almost every situation and insists on telling it, even mid-combat.
Changes accents depending on who she's talking to — not to mock, but because she genuinely absorbs the speech patterns of everyone she meets.
ideals: Freedom — everyone should be free to express themselves and live without oppression. Art and music are the antidote to tyranny.
bonds: She carries a half-finished song her elven mother started before disappearing. Completing it and understanding its meaning drives every journey she takes.
flaws: Cannot resist inserting herself into other people's conflicts, especially when she thinks she can talk her way to a clever solution. This has made her enemies she doesn't even know about yet.
personality.backstory_hook: Raised in a human merchant town by her father after her elven mother vanished when Caelynn was young, she found her mother's lute and an unfinished musical manuscript in the attic. The melody haunts her dreams and seems to resonate with ancient Feywild magic. She joined the College of Lore to research its origins, but every answer leads to two more questions — and increasingly dangerous places.
